messages:
Emma: Quick follow-up from the 2026-03-11 postmortem — we need to lock owners/timelines for the test and eval work that will prevent the KV-cache eviction regression from recurring. Posting a proposed slate of action items below.

Emma: Proposed items (short):
1) regression test: reproducer + CI check (owner: Raj) 
2) prompt-set: targeted prompts that hit long-seq tails (owner: Tyler)
3) load test: mixed small-batch + long-seqlen profile in Dedicated env (owner: Maria)
4) chaos drill: autoscaler + pool compaction scenario (owner: Blake)
5) alerting rule: tail-latency > 95p + cache-evict rate (owner: SRE)

Raj: I can own the regression harness. I already have a local repro script — will extract into pytest and add to the crit-regressions CI job. Targeting EOW next Fri (2026-03-20).

Tyler: I'll build the prompt-set. Suggest we include ~40 prompts: some synthetic long-text with repeated prefixes + a few real customer prompts (anonymized). Will add to evals repo under evals/regress/kv_eviction_promptset. ETA Tue (2026-03-17).

Maria: For load test, I want a small cluster run that mimics Dedicated burst behavior. Can we get a Dedicated dev pool for the run? If yes I can run gradeload with these params:
```
workload: mixed
users: 50
qps: 120
batching: variable(1-8)
seq_len_p95: 2048
duration: 2h
```
I'll coordinate infra provisioning with @Blake. Targeting 3/24 morning slot.

Blake: I can carve out a temporary Dedicated dev pool. Will add a ticket -> infra backlog with ETA 3/21 for provisioning. Also will attach logs bucket and sampling for KV metrics.

Emma: Acceptance criteria we agreed in the postmortem:
- regression CI fails if reproducer triggers >10% increased eviction rate or >2x p95 latency regression
- prompt-set coverage includes at least 10 real-anon prompts and 30 synthetic edge cases
- load test run must exercise autoscaler + compaction path and produce regression dashboard
- chaos drill must have documented runbook and rollback steps

Raj: Notes for the regression PR: will add a flakey guard and a reference link to the postmortem doc. Command I plan to add to CI:
```
pytest tests/regress/test_kv_cache.py::test_tail_eviction --runslow --junitxml=artifacts/kv_eviction.xml
```
Also adding a short reproducer snippet to help debugging in future.

Tyler: For the prompt-set bakeoff, propose a tiny evaluation harness that runs both quantized and float model variants and flags quality divergence >5% BLEU/ROUGE (or a task-specific metric). Will PR eval harness by 3/17.

Maria: For the chaos drill, propose we run 2 scenarios: (A) autoscaler oscillation (scale up -> rapid down) and (B) pool compaction under mixed load. Each scenario: runbook + checklist + post-run notes. I'll schedule a 60-min drill on 3/26. 

Emma: Owner summary + timelines (please ack or update):
- Raj: regression harness -> 2026-03-20
- Tyler: prompt-set + eval harness -> 2026-03-17
- Maria: load test + chaos drill scheduling -> provisioning 3/21, run 3/24 & 3/26
- Blake: infra provisioning -> 2026-03-21
- SRE (TBD): alerting rule -> assign in Monday SRE sync

Raj: Ack. I'll open the PR and link the CI job to the regression pipeline.

Blake: Ack. Ticket created: INFRA-4921.

postmortem-bot: Postmortem follow-ups recorded: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2026-03-kv-eviction. Action items synced to task tracker.

Emma: Thanks all — we should run the bakeoff + chaos drill before the next release. If anyone hits blockers, ping me or drop updates here. :thumbsup:
